source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
To resolve an attack on an **attached unit**, use the highest T among:

- its bodyguard models, while it has any, even if a leader or support unit in it has a different T
- its leader or support models, once only those remain

For an attached unit, rules triggered by a unit being **destroyed** trigger only when the final model it began the battle with is destroyed.
